classes.name: UserInputService
classes.note: Keyboard, mouse and gamepad buttons only: touch, gyro and accelerometer input are reported as absent, and no TextBox takes focus yet.
classes.doc: Reports raw key, mouse and gamepad input to client scripts, and holds the cursor settings. On the server it sees no input.

properties.name: MouseBehavior
properties.doc: Whether the cursor moves freely or is held at the window centre or in place. The window follows it; headless runs only record it.

properties.name: KeyboardEnabled
properties.doc: True when a keyboard is present.

properties.name: MouseEnabled
properties.doc: True when a mouse is present.

properties.name: TouchEnabled
properties.doc: True when a touch screen is present. Touch input is not supported, so it is always false.

properties.name: GamepadEnabled
properties.doc: True while a gamepad is connected.

properties.name: AccelerometerEnabled
properties.doc: True when the device has an accelerometer; always false here.

properties.name: GyroscopeEnabled
properties.doc: True when the device has a gyroscope; always false here.

methods.name: IsKeyDown
methods.doc: True while the key is held.

methods.name: IsMouseButtonPressed
methods.doc: True while the mouse button (MouseButton1, 2 or 3) is held.

methods.name: IsGamepadButtonDown
methods.note: Every connected pad reports as Gamepad1.
methods.doc: True while the button is held on that gamepad.

methods.name: GetMouseLocation
methods.doc: The cursor position in window pixels, from the top-left corner.

methods.name: GetMouseDelta
methods.doc: How far the mouse moved this frame, in pixels, scaled by MouseDeltaSensitivity.

methods.name: GetKeysPressed
methods.doc: An InputObject for every key held now.

methods.name: GetMouseButtonsPressed
methods.doc: An InputObject for every mouse button held now.

methods.name: GetLastInputType
methods.doc: The kind of the latest input (Keyboard, MouseMovement, MouseButton1, Gamepad1 and so on).

methods.name: GetFocusedTextBox
methods.note: No TextBox takes keyboard focus yet, so it is always nil.
methods.doc: The text box the keyboard types into, or nil.

methods.name: GetConnectedGamepads
methods.note: Every connected pad reports as Gamepad1.
methods.doc: The gamepads connected now.

methods.name: GetGamepadConnected
methods.note: Every connected pad reports as Gamepad1.
methods.doc: True when that gamepad is connected.

events.name: InputBegan
events.doc: A key or button went down, or a touch began. The flag is true when the engine already used the input (a focused text box).

events.name: InputChanged
events.doc: The mouse moved, the wheel turned or a stick moved.

events.name: InputEnded
events.doc: A key or button went up.

events.name: LastInputTypeChanged
events.doc: The kind of input the player uses changed.

events.name: JumpRequest
events.doc: The player pressed a jump control (Space, or the gamepad A button).

events.name: TextBoxFocused
events.note: No TextBox takes keyboard focus yet, so it never fires.
events.doc: A text box took keyboard focus.

events.name: TextBoxFocusReleased
events.note: No TextBox takes keyboard focus yet, so it never fires.
events.doc: A text box gave up keyboard focus.

classes.name: InputObject
classes.doc: One input as scripts see it: which key or device, its state, and where the cursor or stick is. The same object is reused for every event of one key or device.

properties.name: KeyCode
properties.doc: The key or gamepad button, or None for mouse and stick input.

properties.name: UserInputType
properties.doc: The device kind: Keyboard, MouseButton1, MouseMovement, Gamepad1 and so on.

properties.name: Position
properties.doc: For mouse input, the cursor in window pixels with the wheel position in Z; for a stick, its value.

properties.name: Delta
properties.doc: For mouse movement, the motion in pixels; for the wheel, the turn in Z.

methods.name: IsModifierKeyDown
methods.doc: True while the Shift, Ctrl, Alt or Meta key (either side) is held.

classes.name: ContextActionService
classes.note: No on-screen touch buttons: the touch-button arguments and the button setters are recorded only.
classes.doc: Binds named actions to keys and buttons. Each input goes to the bound actions from the highest priority down, until one sinks it.

methods.name: BindAction
methods.doc: Binds an action to the given KeyCode or UserInputType items at the default priority. The function gets the action name, the input state and the InputObject, and returns Sink (the default) or Pass.

methods.name: BindActionAtPriority
methods.doc: Like BindAction, with a priority: higher priorities see the input first.

methods.name: UnbindAction
methods.doc: Removes the action. An input it holds gets a Cancel call.

methods.name: UnbindAllActions
methods.doc: Removes every action this script context bound.

methods.name: GetBoundActionInfo
methods.doc: A table describing the action (its priority, inputs and settings), empty when it is not bound.

methods.name: GetAllBoundActionInfo
methods.doc: The GetBoundActionInfo table of every bound action, by name.

methods.name: SetTitle
methods.note: Recorded only: there are no touch buttons.
methods.doc: Sets the text of the action's touch button.

methods.name: SetDescription
methods.note: Recorded only: there are no touch buttons.
methods.doc: Sets the description of the action.

methods.name: SetImage
methods.note: Recorded only: there are no touch buttons.
methods.doc: Sets the image of the action's touch button.

methods.name: SetPosition
methods.note: Recorded only: there are no touch buttons.
methods.doc: Sets where the action's touch button sits.

methods.name: GetButton
methods.note: There are no touch buttons, so it is always nil.
methods.doc: The action's touch button, or nil.

events.name: LocalToolEquipped
events.doc: A tool was equipped. Tools are not supported.

events.name: LocalToolUnequipped
events.doc: A tool was unequipped. Tools are not supported.
